Non-judgmentally is the first HOW skill. Notice evaluations when they arise and return to facts, consequences, preferences, and values.

## Non-Judgmentally {#non-judgmentally}
## Source / Printable Copies

- [Non-Judgmentally source pages](/resources/mindfulness/mindfulness-nonjudgmentally-source.pdf)

## Text Version / Adapted Text

The HOW skills describe the stance used while observing, describing, or participating: non-judgmentally, one-mindfully, and effectively.

### Non-Judgmentally {#non-judgmentally}

Notice judgments as thoughts. Return to observable facts, preferences, values, and consequences. Non-judgment does not mean approving of harm or giving up discernment; it means reducing labels that hide useful information.
